title: Algorithm or Creative? Disentangling Algorithmic Divergent Delivery from User Ad Preferences in Digital Platforms
abstract: arXiv:2605.23706v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Online advertising platforms host hundreds of thousands of A/B tests, but the platform's delivery algorithm routes each creative to the audience it predicts will engage. Every two-arm test therefore conflates the creative's effect with the algorithm's targeting response, and adjusting for the realized audience is biased because audience is a post-treatment mediator. We propose a three-arm design that adds an arm exposing the algorithm to the treatment metadata while holding the user-facing creative identical to control, separately point-identifying the algorithmic delivery and ad creative effects. In a live Meta campaign with a women-targeted text fragment, the algorithmic delivery channel raises female impression share by $+2.27$ ppt, while the visible creative leaves delivery composition statistically unchanged. translated_title: 算法还是创意？在数字平台中解耦算法差异化投放与用户广告偏好
translated_abstract: 在线广告平台运行着数十万个A/B测试，但平台的投放算法会将每个创意路由到其预测会互动的受众。因此，每个双臂测试都会将创意的效果与算法的定向响应混为一谈，而针对实际受众进行调整是有偏的，因为受众是处理后中介变量。我们提出一种三臂设计，增加一个臂，在保持面向用户的创意与对照组相同的同时，将算法暴露于处理元数据，从而分别点识别算法投放和广告创意效果。在一项针对女性的文本片段的Meta实时活动中，算法投放渠道使女性展示份额提高了+2.27个百分点，而可见创意在统计上未改变投放构成。传统的双臂测试会将整个投放转变归因于创意。该设计隔离了贡献。
tldr: 提出三臂实验设计，将算法投放效果与广告创意效果分离，发现算法定向是投放变化的主要来源，而创意本身影响不显著。
en_tdlr: A three-arm experimental design disentangles algorithmic delivery from ad creative effects, showing algorithmic targeting drives delivery shifts while the creative itself has negligible impact.
